## Objective
Implement critical MSN agent workflows, review/test, deploy, commit and push all changes to main. User explicitly authorized deployment and push. Six Grok collaborators; root integrates and publishes. No Astra.

## Decisions
Frozen coordination server+CLI at /tmp/msn-implementation-20260917/msn ROLE; shared code /home/tomas/Projects/msn. Root owns args/lib/main/agent.rs/task_client.rs/entry+history tests, integration and deployment. No subagent commits/deploys. Do not spawn further agents or broad mutation jobs.
Features: start (identity + one bounded catchup page, no cursors); peek/commit (explicit separate processing progress); readable msn.task.v1 ledger; participant exact evidence GET + show. Scope does not include filtered inboxes, automatic summaries, claims server, MCP, subscriptions.

## Open tasks
- idea-grok01: processing.rs + processing tests. Finish #440 page validation: hasMore, nextCursor matching actual last ID/empty committed watermark, ids after committed prefix, correct tenant/channel. No write on invalid response. APIs wired; targeted tests.
- idea-grok02: tasks.rs + task tests. Finish #441 acceptance/reason/creator retention, bounded fields, #425/#439 effective states/historical dependencies. No cargo-mutants sweep. Publish final contract.
- idea-grok03: evidence endpoint/tests complete, 61 Worker tests passed. No further work unless review finds defect.
- idea-grok04: isolated tests/critical.integration.mjs delivered. Root now runs it; test file owned by G04 if resumed.
- idea-grok05: docs/guide/ADR delivered; final effective-state schema #439 must match docs before release.
- idea-grok06: independent read-only review of actual diff/modules. Report blockers promptly; root already flagged page validation, dependency/evidence false completion, output sorting, acceptance/reason retention.
- Root: integration, entry/history tests, full suites, final browser+live verification, deploy, commit+push remote main including saved ideation artifacts. Remote main matched HEAD at start.

## Blockers
Temporary collaboration outage restored. Parallel mutation worktrees filled write quota; root stopped that task job and deleted only its four generated temp worktrees. Never restart broad mutation runs. Messages survived through #444; recovery #445. Retry failed sends with same keys.

## Artifacts
Current code compiles. Focused root tests passed (6 entry, 5 history before extra sort regression, 7 processing, 26 task before refinements). Worker point endpoint passed 61 tests incl10 evidence cases. Changes uncommitted. Frozen server is http://127.0.0.1:8798 workspace swarm channel implementation; Tomas existing key works.

## Next actions
Finish scoped correctness fixes; root runs tests and hands final diff to reviewer, then authorized deployment/commit/push. Post concise source-backed results, not repeated full contracts.

## Unresolved
Task record state is EFFECTIVE, never closed with unresolved conflict/evidence/dependency; assertedState preserves the recorded lifecycle. #439 supersedes old closed+conflict output sketches. Task list pins first headCursor, checks historyRevision throughout and final check, fails on incomplete scan/32MiB bound; sorted task output pagination separately. Ready evidence must be earlier surviving channel rows. Actor is outer message.username.
CRITICAL recipe: start -> peek -> work INCLUDING sends/task events with stable keys -> commit actual processed prefix, normally THIS peek nextCursor. Never commit before sending required results; never blindly commit highestFetched after smaller replay. One ordered worker per reader; at-least-once inputs, not exactly-once effects.

## Evidence
Assignments #391–397; root CLI/history contract #398; evidence delivered #421; critical corrections #425–426; test/docs delivered #432/#437; effective task state #439; root review work #440–444; outage recovery #445.

## Objective
Deliver the critical MSN agent workflows with Grok collaboration, review, tests, production deployment, and remote main publication.

## Decisions
Canonical channel log remains the source of truth. start returns one bounded snapshot/tail page plus validated identity and work recipe without moving cursors. peek/commit keeps processing progress separate from delivery. Work INCLUDING sends/task results with stable keys precedes committing THIS peek's processed prefix. Task events derive ownership, blockers, review, evidence, and effective state without server locks. show fetches one surviving message; deleted evidence cannot prove completion. Snapshots remain authored summaries.

## Completed work
Six Cursor Grok contributors handled processing, task projection, evidence endpoint, integration tests, documentation, and independent review; root integrated and released. No Astra. Review corrections include strict page identity/cursors, dependency and deleted-evidence propagation, bounded task records, results-before-commit instructions, and clearing reassigned evidence. Final app review #467, ready #468, verified closure #469. Additional smoke/guide review #472 found no blockers. Existing macOS test path assertion reproduced and corrected #473–474.

## Verification
TypeScript, Biome, Rust format/Clippy/full suite, Worker/Node tests, 58 desktop/mobile browser tests, and participant/snapshot/critical real-Worker integration suites passed. Focused final entry-budget tests passed 8/8. Guide desktop/mobile cases rerun 2/2. Production critical smoke and legacy tenant/concurrency/revocation smoke passed. Initial harness assumptions about cleanup and homepage text were corrected. No successful broad mutation campaign is claimed.

## Deployment and artifacts
Production https://msn.rodat-human-ada.workers.dev, Worker version 9230a842-2aab-486d-bad0-5ec4c089b54e. Final guide layout no longer compresses code blocks. Report docs/critical-agent-workflows-2026-09-17.md; durable transcript/checkpoints/tasks/model manifest docs/examples/critical-2026-09-17/. Prior ranked ideation and evidence are included in the pending commit. Credentials and private raw session logs are excluded.

## Remaining release actions
At this checkpoint, root must commit/push all changes to remote main and verify GitHub CI/release. Do not mistake deployment or this authored summary for proof that the remote push already happened. Follow later channel messages and GitHub for the release result.

## Operational lessons
A broad mutation job exhausted local write quota and briefly interrupted coordination; root stopped the job, removed only its generated scratch builds, restored the persisted channel, and restarted G02 in fresh context. Seven distinct Cursor sessions across six contributor identities. Dedicated coordination source prevented shared edits from disrupting the discussion. One local trial is not a performance benchmark.

## Access
Local channel remains at http://127.0.0.1:8798, workspace swarm, channel implementation. Tomas's existing participant key remains valid. No keys belong in snapshots or exports.

## Evidence
Assignments #391–398; evolving contracts/corrections #425–426, #439–446, #453–464; final review #467; task lifecycle #465/#468/#469; deployment verification and release polish #470–474.
